item.title: Photons, Thresholds, and Tracers — Mammography, Tomosynthesis & Dense-Breast Screening (H036), DXA Bone Density, Spondylosis Artifacts & NORA/SCOOP Paradoxes (H037) & Nuclear Medicine SPECT/PET-CT Theranostics (H038)
item.description: Clinical Cluster & Diagnostic Physics synthesis of mammography/DBT (H036), DXA bone densitometry (H037), and nuclear medicine SPECT/PET-CT (H038): Friedewald DBT (n=454,850), DENSE MRI (n=40,373), BI-RADS discordance, and 1,000-woman screening funnels; DXA spondylosis false elevation, LSC math, NORA (n=200,160) & SCOOP (n=12,483), and pre-drug osteomalacia screening; and FDG superscans, proPSMA (n=302), SPECT balanced ischemia vs. PET CFR, cold myeloma vs. flare, PIOPED II V/Q, I-131 fetal thyroid protection, and Deauville 1-5.

item.title: The Pocket That Did Not Predict the Trial — Fragile X FMR1 Methylation PCR, Grm5 Rescue, Mavoglurant in Human mGlu5 (PDB 4OO9), [11C]ABP688 PET & FXLEARN
item.description: Behind the Curtain Pharmacology Pilot 79: FMR1 CGG repeat-primed and HpaII methylation PCR (Chen et al.), Fmr1 x Grm5 genetic cross (Dölen et al. 2007) and CTEP chronic rescue (Michalon et al. 2012), mavoglurant (AFQ056) bound 8 Å below the membrane surface in human mGlu5 (PDB 4OO9, Asn747/Ser805/Ser809), human [11C]ABP688 PET receptor occupancy, why Jacquemont's (2011) 7-person full-methylation subgroup failed prospective replication in Phase 2b (Berry-Kravis et al. 2016), and the FXLEARN pediatric language trial (log10 contrast -0.10, P=.16).

item.title: The Colon Cancer Signal in the Diet Survey — Fecal Immunochemical Screening Conversion, MGMT Cys145 Suicide Alkyl Transfer, Le Leu's Red-Meat vs. Butyrylated-Starch Rectal Crypt Biopsies & UK Biobank GxE
item.description: Separating stool hemoglobin screening, mucosal adduct biology, and observational nutritional epidemiology: FIT buffer-to-feces (µg Hb/g) conversion, human MGMT Cys145 suicidal O6-methylguanine repair (PDB 1EH6/1T38), Le Leu et al. (2015) randomized high-red-meat ± butyrylated resistant starch rectal biopsy O6MeG adduct trial, and gene-by-diet interaction studies.

item.title: The Allele at the Mediterranean Table — TCF7L2 rs7903146 Islet Chromatin Accessibility, Beta-Catenin 1JPW Interface, PREDIMED Stroke Subgroup & the 2018 Trial Reanalysis
item.description: From intronic TCF7L2 rs7903146 C-to-T open chromatin in human pancreatic islets (Gaulton et al. 2010) and beta-catenin groove binding (PDB 1JPW) to Corella et al.'s (2013) PREDIMED genotype-stratified stroke analysis (n=7,018 / 4,727) and Estruch et al.'s (2018) NEJM retraction-republication accounting for household and clinic non-randomization.

item.title: The Marathon, the Microbe, and the Mouse — Boston Marathon Veillonella atypica Stool Signal, Mouse [13C3]Lactate Gut Crossing, Colorectal Propionate & Human Crossover Trials
item.description: Dissecting the Veillonella atypica exercise-microbiome hypothesis (Scheiman et al. 2019 Nature Medicine vs. human crossover trials): relative 16S stool abundance after the Boston Marathon, IV [13C3]lactate mouse cecal tracing at 17–19 minutes, 32-mouse AB-BA treadmill crossover vs. intrarectal propionate instillation, and human randomized endpoints.

item.title: The Monkeys on Two Different Clocks — Wisconsin vs. NIA Rhesus Caloric Restriction Survival, Diet Composition & Feeding Schedules, Sestrin2 5DJ4 & CALERIE
item.description: Reconciling the University of Wisconsin (2009, 2014) and NIA (2012, 2017) rhesus macaque caloric restriction colonies: age at onset, purified 28.5% sucrose ad libitum controls vs. natural-ingredient rationed controls, age-related vs. all-cause Cox hazard ratios, human Sestrin2 leucine-pocket structure (PDB 5DJ4), and the human 2-year CALERIE trial.

item.title: The Diet That Went First — Ad Libitum Plant-Based Low-Fat vs. Animal Ketogenic Crossover, Day-15 Sequence Carryover & Ketone/GLP-1 Dynamics
item.description: Methodological and physiological dissection of Hall et al. (2021) and Sciarrillo et al. (2024): how comparing within-person low-fat vs. ketogenic intake (-689 kcal/day) differs from comparing randomized 28-day diet orders (-921 kcal/day for ketogenic-first), and how no-washout crossovers entangle current menu with prior diet history.

item.title: The Tree That Stayed in the Timber — Forensic Timber STR & Chloroplast Profiling, Koompassia Log-to-Stump Matching, Shorea Databases & UNODC Likelihood Ratios
item.description: Forensic botany and timber DNA identification: matching three seized Koompassia malaccensis logs (L75, L79, L80) to stump S12 across a 1,465-tree Malaysian reference database (Lee et al. 2025), Shorea leprosula population (45.9%) vs. regional (88.7%) self-assignment across 1,410 trees (Ng et al. 2022), chloroplast vs. nuclear STR inheritance (Ng et al. 2017), Eucalyptus DNA and dendrochronological exclusion (Roman et al. 2020), and UNODC (2016) likelihood-ratio principles.

item.title: The Water Temple's Calendar — Balinese Subak Irrigation Networks, Lansing & Kremer's Pest-vs.-Water Tradeoff Models & Green Revolution Disruption
item.description: Systems ecology and historical ethnography of Balinese water temples (Lansing 1987, Lansing & Kremer 1993): how ritual cropping calendars balance upstream water scarcity against synchronized fallow pest control, what the 1970s Green Revolution natural experiment revealed, and critiques from historical archival records.

item.title: The Eyes on the Wall — Bateson's Honesty-Box Coffee Experiment, Watching-Eyes Meta-Analyses & Replication Boundaries
item.description: Critical audit of the watching-eyes literature from Bateson et al. (2006) breakroom coffee honesty-box study to large-sample preregistered replications and meta-analyses.

item.title: The Blank Cell in the Big Gods Debate — Seshat Missing-Data Coding, Chronological Priors & Retraction Reanalysis
item.description: Epistemological and statistical dissection of the Seshat Big Gods controversy: how coding unknown historical cells as zeros shifted the inferred appearance of moralizing gods relative to social complexity, and why absence of evidence, documented absence, and first attestation are distinct.

item.title: Fixing Medical Evidence With Bayesian Statistics
item.itunes:title: Fixing Medical Evidence With Bayesian Statistics
item.itunes:author: Matthew S. Yorek
item.description: Bayesian and statistical critique of the Cochrane Library’s reliance on sparse meta-analyses for global medical decision-making. Employs Laplace’s urn models and Bayesian probability tables to demonstrate how small study samples distort clinical truth, proposing a more robust framework for updating medical evidence in the face of uncertainty.

item.description: Statistical and methodological transition from frequentist inference to Bayesian frameworks in clinical trial design and economic modeling. Investigates Markov switching regimes and transition probabilities to reconcile unexpected tumor regression data with formal architectural foundations of evidence-based medicine.

item.description: Statistical and administrative critique of differential privacy algorithms applied to federal demographic databases such as the US Census. Evaluates how injected algorithmic noise distorts resource allocation models, transforming theoretical cyber defense into tangible public funding deficits.

item.description: Epistemological and statistical audit of Bayesian inference as a framework for clinical and strategic decision-making under conditions of uncertainty. Evaluates the integration of prior probability distributions with Abraham Wald’s loss functions to optimize diagnostic accuracy and therapeutic interventions in complex medical landscapes.

Evaluates the epistemological evolution toward Bayesian inference, examining how modern clinical trials continuously update predictive probability distributions under mathematical uncertainty.

item.itunes:title: How Big Data Broke Modern Statistics
item.itunes:author: Matthew S. Yorek

Contrasts the Hubble Deep Field's transformative sampling with the socio-technical mechanisms that lead to proxy bias and the failure of massive behavioral datasets in modern science.

item.title: The Eugenic Origins of Modern Statistics
item.itunes:title: The Eugenic Origins of Modern Statistics
item.itunes:author: Matthew S. Yorek
item.description: Epistemological audit of the historical development of frequentist statistics and its roots in 19th-century eugenic ideologies. Traces how mathematical tools designed to filter noise in complex biological and social datasets were forged within a framework of intellectual warfare and prejudice that continues to influence modern drug approvals.

item.title: The Calabar Bean & the Missing Signal — Physostigmine, Acetylcholinesterase Ser203 Carbamylation, Antimuscarinic Delirium & QRS Counterfactuals
item.description: From Efik esere ordeal records in Old Calabar and Thomas Richard Fraser's Edinburgh experiments to human acetylcholinesterase Ser203 carbamylation (4EY4/1GQR), false-positive urine TCA immunoassays, and ECG QRS gating in antimuscarinic delirium.

item.title: The Pause That Finally Had a Time — Implantable Loop Recorder Asystole Masquerading as Epilepsy (Kanjwal 2010) vs. 38-Second Ictal Asystole on Simultaneous EEG/ECG (Nandkeolyar 2018), RAST Yield & Recorder Artifacts
item.description: Behind the Curtain of ambulatory ECG and implantable loop recording (H041): Kanjwal et al.'s (2010) loop-recorder capture of complete heart block and prolonged asystole causing convulsive syncope previously treated as epilepsy, contrasted with Nandkeolyar et al.'s (2018) simultaneous video-EEG/ECG capture of right temporal seizure onset preceding a 38-second ictal asystole, Krahn's randomized RAST diagnostic yield (14/27 vs. 6/30), and Domenichini's (2023) false-positive pause artifacts.

item.title: Half-Lives, Pancreatic Epitopes, and Portal Shunts — Human Therapeutic Drug Monitoring, Vancomycin AUC24 & Winter-Tozer/DigiFab Traps (H056), Canine/Feline Monoclonal Spec cPL/fPL & Triaditis (V025) & Dynamic Paired Bile Acids, Maltese Artifacts & PSS vs. MVD (V026)
item.description: One Medicine synthesis of human therapeutic drug monitoring (H056), canine/feline pancreatic lipase (V025), and dynamic serum bile acid stimulation (V026): phenytoin zero-order kinetics & Winter-Tozer free fraction, digoxin 6-8h & post-DigiFab traps, Bayesian vancomycin AUC24/MIC, and EDTA whole-blood tacrolimus LC-MS/MS; Spec cPL/fPL vs. catalytic lipase failure, feline shared-ampulla Triaditis + B12, cTLI for EPI, and foreign-body bystander cPL; and 12h/2h bile acids, the jaundice ban, Maltese chromogens, and Protein C (<70% PSS vs. >=70% benign MVD).

item.title: Windows, Workloads, and Diffusing Gas — Ambulatory ECG Cadence & EMBRACE/CRYSTAL AF Trials (H041), Exercise Stress Physiology, HRR & ISCHEMIA (H042) & Plethysmographic Lung Volumes & DLCO/KCO (H043)
item.description: Clinical Cluster & Cardiopulmonary Physiology synthesis of ambulatory ECG monitoring (H041), cardiac exercise stress testing (H042), and lung volumes/DLCO (H043): Barrett's paired patch cohort (n=146), EMBRACE (n=572) & CRYSTAL AF (n=441), nocturnal vagal variants, and toothbrush pseudo-VT; coronary autoregulation, ST localization laws, LBBB vasodilator rule, Cole's HRR (n=2,428), WOMEN & ISCHEMIA; and Boyle's Law plethysmography vs. gas dilution, Roughton-Forster DLCO/KCO physics, CPFE/PAH phenotypes, ppo-DLCO, and race-neutral GLI Z-scores.

item.title: When the Immune System Points at the Wrong Target — Allergy Component Traps, Anaphylaxis Tryptase & Autoimmune Antibody Mimics
item.description: Clinical problem cluster in allergy & autoimmune immunology (H024, H025): IgE sensitization vs. clinical allergy, Ara h 2 vs. Ara h 8 component resolved diagnostics (Kansen 2021 <=0.1 vs. >=5.0 kUA/L), basophil activation flow cytometry (Santos 2014), unvalidated commercial IgG food panels & rice-milk kwashiorkor infant edema, delayed 3-7h alpha-gal syndrome, PALACE direct oral penicillin challenge noninferiority, perioperative chlorhexidine anaphylaxis cardiac arrest, paired acute vs. baseline mast-cell tryptase (1.2x baseline + 2 ng/mL) & postmortem femoral tryptase; paired with HEp-2 IIF (31.7% healthy positive at 1:40 vs. 5.0% at 1:160) vs. ELISA ANA2 discordance, Crithidia luciliae vs. multiplex anti-dsDNA (209/586 discordant pairs), 48/52 false-positive commercial Scl-70 cleared by immunodiffusion, passive IVIG autoantibody transfer, Bartonella endocarditis mimicking PR3-ANCA glomerulonephritis, hydralazine MPO-ANCA pulmonary-renal syndrome, rivaroxaban false lupus anticoagulant, and paired CSF vs. serum anti-NMDAR testing.

item.title: Proviral Hiding Places & Shedding Windows — Feline Leukemia p27 Antigen, FIV Maternal Antibodies & Canine Parvovirus SNAP Traps
item.description: Clinical problem cluster in veterinary virology & Bayesian screening (V027, V028, V001): Feline Leukemia Virus (FeLV) soluble p27 capsid antigen ELISA vs. IFA & quantitative proviral DNA/RNA PCR across abortive, regressive (occult bone-marrow integration transmitted via blood transfusion!), and progressive stages; FIV gp40/p24 antibody testing vs. colostral maternal antibodies in kittens <6 months & vaccine interference; low-prevalence positive predictive value (PPV) math requiring orthogonal confirmation; paired with Canine Parvovirus (CPV-2a/2b/2c) fecal antigen ELISA false negatives (dilution, mucosal antibody sequestration, narrow shedding window) vs. PCR post-MLV vaccine false positives.

item.title: Delayed Hypersensitivity & Biphasic Spirochetes — Mantoux Tuberculin, ESAT-6 IGRA, Bovine TB & Canine Leptospira MAT Paradoxes
item.description: One Medicine zoonotic immunology & infectious disease deep dive (H020, V006, V030): Robert Koch's tuberculin & Seibert's PPD-S 5 TU Mantoux induration (5/10/15 mm risk-stratified Bayesian cutoffs) vs. bovine caudal-fold & comparative cervical M. bovis/M. avium testing, RD1-locus ESAT-6/CFP-10 Interferon-Gamma Release Assays (QuantiFERON-TB Gold Plus & T-SPOT.TB), BCG specificity, serial healthcare-worker wobble-zone reversions, and miliary TB anergy, paired with canine & zoonotic Leptospira Microscopic Agglutination Test (MAT) paradoxical serovar cross-reactivity, post-vaccine titers, 4-fold convalescent rises, and biphasic blood-to-urine lipL32 PCR windows.

item.title: Hidden Assumptions in Everyday Numbers — Blood Pressure Cuff Physics, HbA1c Red-Cell Lifespans, Lung Loops & CT Hounsfield Math
item.description: Clinical problem cluster (H039, H007, H006, H005, H032): how oscillometric cuffs measure MAP and algorithmically guess systolic/diastolic BP, ADAG HbA1c wide glucose prediction intervals (7.0% = 123–185 mg/dL) & hemolytic/dapsone/asplenia red-cell lifespan traps, fixed 0.70 FEV1/FVC elderly COPD overdiagnosis vs. GLI Z-scores, and chest radiograph blind zones vs. CT Hounsfield attenuation & bolus-timing artifacts.

item.title: Culturing Invisible Invaders & Herd-Level Stakes — Sepsis Bottles, Canine Cystocentesis, Coggins Law & Imperfect Gold Standards
item.description: One Medicine infectious & regulatory cluster (H018, H003, V002, V010, V003, V004, V005, V006): Poisson 40-60 mL blood-culture volume physics vs. skin contaminants, why human urine leukocyte esterase dipsticks fail in dogs and cats, cystocentesis vs. voided CFU cutoffs, ZnSO4 centrifugal fecal flotation physics, canine heartworm antigen blocking, Equine Coggins serial ELISA->AGID logic, and Bovine TB herd-specificity collapse (Sp^N) & Hui-Walter latent-class Bayes.

item.title: Why a Prolonged Clotting Time Doesn't Mean You'll Bleed — Human & Veterinary Coagulation Traps, Factor XII & Citrate Tube Math
item.description: One Medicine comparative deep dive (H011, V009): feline & human Factor XII >120s aPTT surgical paradox, lupus anticoagulant thrombosis vs. acquired Factor VIII inhibitors in 1:1 mixing studies, hematocrit >55% blue-top citrate artifacts, canine brodifacoum Factor VII 6-hour clock, ISI exponentiation, and Bayesian D-dimer NPV.

item.title: Three Clocks in Chest Pain & Shock — Serial High-Sensitivity Troponin Deltas, Silent ECGs & Arterial Blood Gas Physics
item.description: Clinical problem cluster (H004, H015, H014): 12-lead ECG occlusion blind spots vs. urgent reperfusion before blood results, FDA 510(k) hs-troponin LoB/LoD/LoQ & sex-specific 99th-percentile math, 0/1h Reference Change Value deltas, macrotroponin & biotin traps, and Severinghaus/Clark ABG + 128-wavelength Co-Oximetry physics.

item.title: The Thermostat That Lies Across Species — Human Thyroid Traps, Greyhound Baselines, Occult Feline Hyperthyroidism & Canine Adrenal Dynamics
item.description: One Medicine comparative deep dive (H009, V021, V022, V023): human biotin fake-Graves' storm vs. equilibrium dialysis, healthy Greyhound low basal T4, feline azotemia masking hyperthyroidism, canine Addison's TSH surges & Cushing's LDDST escape, plus Index of Individuality (II ~ 0.35), log-linear TSH-fT4 gain, and RCV math.
